svg.aria-label: A formula and a trace go into tl-mltl. evaluate_closed or evaluate_prefix returns a verdict, here true at time 0, and pending when the prefix does not decide it. analyze_horizon returns a lookahead of 2 and a buffer of 3 instants. map_to_c2po returns a manifest with the C2PO expression and SHA-256 digests of its input and output. C2PO and R2U2 run outside this crate, and compare_external classifies their verdict against the reference verdict, here 8 of 8 supported cases agree.
